notes: Bergenfield is designated as a Qualified Urban Aid Municipality (QUAM) for the Fourth Round (2025-2035), which exempts it from prospective need (new construction) obligations under P.L.2024, c.2. QUAMs are exempt because lower-income housing is already disproportionately concentrated there. A fourth-round HEFSP filing was not located on library.njcourts.gov. The Borough maintains existing AHO overlay zones (B-1 AHO, B-2 AHO per Article VIIA, and Unmet Need Overlay Zone per Article VIIB) enacted under prior rounds. Rehabilitation present need number was not found in search results (would appear in DCA Excel spreadsheet). No fourth-round settlement with FSHC identified. Borough is NOT part of the LLRP lawsuit coalition. The 15% rental / 20% for-sale inclusionary requirement is codified in Borough zoning. Specific present need rehabilitation obligation number requires direct access to DCA spreadsheet.
